system.description:
You pulse aether into the air and perceive the world by how it resonates with the energy.

You immediately become aware of the following in a 10-space-radius.

  • The general shape of any walls or open spaces, and their makeup thereof.

  • The presence of any living or magical creatures, as well as their general size or shape.

  • The presence of any magical effects or items, as well as their general shape, size, and type of magic.

Alternatively, you may use this spell to closely examine a magical item. Doing so allows you to determine:

  • The presence or lack thereof of any enchantments or magical effects the item has.

  • What these enchantments and effects do, how they are constructed, how to activate them, and how to deactivate them.
